logos.name: 1970s husky head
logos.description: Realistic right-facing Jonathan husky head with heavy fur lines, one color (blue #003876) on white. UConn primary athletic mark of the 1970s; replaced for 1981-82. Introduced c. 1970 (SportsLogos dates it 1970-1981; UConn's own timeline just says '1970s'), so first_season 1971 is approximate; the app only needs it for 1977-78 to 1980-81. Caveat: late-1970s basketball press guides (1977-78, 1978-79) also still used the 1960s 'Patriot Husky' spot illustration, and 1981-82 warm-ups carried it, but that was a secondary mark. Vector traced from SportsLogos' 868x901 rendering, TM symbol removed. On a dark card the outer outline is blue (low contrast) but the white face reads clearly; a light plate is optional.

logos.name: Friendly husky on blue circle (1981-2002)
logos.description: Hand-drawn, friendly open-mouthed husky (tongue out) on a solid blue circle. The full primary also had CONNECTICUT arched above and HUSKIES below; this file is the husky-on-circle without lettering, exactly as UConn's own 2013 logo timeline shows it for '1980s & 1990s'. Built as a vector composite: the head traced from SportsLogos' 870x901 head-only rendering (1981-2002 secondary) plus the circle fitted (center/radius, and the primary's own bottom clipping under the fur) from SportsLogos' 1981-2002 primary; matches the primary at 99.4% of pixels outside the lettering. First confirmed in the 1981-82 UConn basketball yearbook/media guide (fall 1981); the same husky drawing headed the official athletics website from 1999 through Aug. 28, 2002. On a dark card the blue circle is subtle but the white head reads clearly.

logos.name: Blue husky with red tongue (2002-2010 colors)
logos.description: Modernized, cartoon-style redraw of the friendly husky: navy and white with red tongue, gray eyes/nose highlight and a gray outer outline. Debuted fall 2002: the official athletics site switched to it between Aug 28 and Sep 2, 2002, and it's on the 2002-03 men's basketball media guide back cover. Several 2013 news stories said 'since 1996', citing a Daily Campus article, but primary evidence contradicts that: the 1999 and Jan-Aug 2002 official site, and the 1999 national-champions emblem, all use the older drawing, and UConn itself says 2002. Vector traced from SportsLogos' 839x901 head-only rendering (TM removed). Colors are the 2002 palette per SportsLogos; the same drawing was recolored in 2010 (see husky-2010). The gray outline works well on a dark card.

logos.name: Blue husky with red tongue (2010-2013 colors)
logos.description: Same drawing as husky-2002, recolored in 2010: darker navy, lighter gray, brighter red. SportsLogos is the only source for the recolor and gives just the year 2010, so starting it with the 2010-11 season is an inference. To ignore the recolor, map 2011-2013 to husky-2002. Vector traced from SportsLogos' 838x901 head-only rendering (registered-trademark symbol removed). The gray outline works well on a dark card.

logos.name: Nike husky head (2013-present)
logos.description: Front-facing, fierce husky head designed with Nike (Graphic Identity Group). Unveiled April 11, 2013: it leaked online, so UConn released it a week before the planned April 18 event. On uniforms of all 24 UConn programs from 2013-14 onward, and still the primary mark in 2026-27. The file is the original vector from Wikipedia ('Connecticut Huskies logo.svg', cleaned 2017) in official colors: navy #000E2F, red #E4002B, gray #A2AAAD, eye blue #A4C8E1. Checked against the ESPN, SportsLogos and NCAA renderings: same design. Not traced. The gray outline works on a dark card.
